description: This file defines extension methods for the WindowsDriver class in the CalculatorUITestFramework, adding retry logic for element search and window switching functionality.

classes.name: WindowsDriverExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for WindowsDriver to enhance element finding with retry logic and window management.

methods.name: TryFindElementByAccessibilityId
methods.description: Attempts to find an element by accessibility ID with retry logic in case the window has been closed.

methods.name: TryFindElementByClassName
methods.description: Attempts to find an element by class name with retry logic in case the window has been closed.

methods.name: SwitchToCurrentWindowHandle
methods.description: Switches the driver context to the first available window handle, typically used after window loss or closure.
